correct_recommendations: Block the merge: handle must verify the signature before any ledger call, and it must ignore an event id it already processed.
invalid_options: Treat the verify order as a suggestion only.
root_cause: handle credits or debits the ledger before verify runs, and it keeps no record of processed event ids.

dependent_facts.true_value: ledger.credit or ledger.debit runs before verify; a forged request moves money and then gets 400
no check on the event id, so a provider retry credits twice
WEBHOOK_SECRET defaults to dev-secret when QUILL_WEBHOOK_SECRET is missing
verify compares with == instead of hmac.compare_digest
a malformed Quill-Signature header raises ValueError

required_questions.question: Can this merge?
required_questions.expected_answer: No, at least the verify order blocks it.

required_questions.question: What must change before merge?
required_questions.expected_answer: Verify first, return 400 before any ledger call; dedupe on event id; probably no default secret.

required_questions.question: Which items are only suggestions?
required_questions.expected_answer: Logging the payload, dead code, header parsing robustness, and possibly compare_digest.

understanding.problem: The webhook handler in pr-311 has security and correctness defects.
understanding.breaks: A forged webhook moves money before the signature check; a retried event credits twice.
understanding.fix: Verify before the ledger calls and dedupe on event id, plus the smaller fixes.
